One of
"disable", "if-possible", or "required"
. Default "disable". Encode using a hardware-accelerated encoder if
available. If set to "required" and no hardware-accelerated encoder is
available, then the render will fail.

## CLI flag

Use `--hardware-acceleration` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                     | Flag                              |
| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)       | `--hardware-acceleration <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)       | `--hardware-acceleration <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark) | `--hardware-acceleration <value>` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#hardwareacceleration)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#hardwareacceleration)
- [`renderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-media-on-web#hardwareacceleration)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setHardwareAcceleration('if-possible');
```
